notes.title: Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
Update Notes 0.0.2
Thank you for purchasing our game in Early Access and thank you for all the support and discussions to help improve our game! Join our discord server at https://discord.gg/2vX99MYb and support our patreon at https://www.patreon.com/afterinfection
We’ve been working on improving graphics and adding new AI and locations to the map in game:
•    Construction Site Location added
•    Updated water Graphics and improves water physics
•    Added Chicken AI that can be harvested and cooked
•    Fixed Terrain Overlap
New items can be found in the game spawning across the map:
•    Electronic Part
•    Gunpowder
•    Sunglasses
•    Holster
•    Green Boonie Hat
A new crafting recipe has been added, and can be used to raid base walls and doors following the updated door and wall health in the previous hotfix:
•    C4 Item can be crafted in a crafting table with 4x Rags, 1x Electronic Part, and 2x gunpowder
•    Code locks now require 2x Iron bars, 1x lock, and 1x electronic part to craft
We made some major improvements and fixed many bugs causing issues on the servers:
•    Fixed items spawning and being inaccessible to pick up in some locations
•    Disabled door collision on open/close
•    Fixed the third-person camera view
•    Fixed the bug with trees and stone being unable to harvest once respawned
•    In the controls settings there is now a new key bind for Auto-Run to be configured
•    There is no longer a respawn cooldown while playing single player mode
We also made some improvements to spelling and punctuation throughout the game. Our developers do not speak English as our first language, and we are doing our best to improve the game translation.
We are now supporting user-hosted servers so be on the lookout for unofficial servers added to the list.
Thanks again for all the support!
